mentions.name: AOO
mentions.description: This is a cross-platform low-latency peer-to-peer audio streaming and messaging library. The C/C++ library can be embedded in host applications or plugins and even runs on embedded devices such as the ESP32. The project includes a Pure Data external and a SuperCollider extension, and there is a third-party Max/MSP external. It is currently in beta with a final release planned for the summer.
